newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - UBS on two steel stocks.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - UBS on two steel stocks.

text.p: -- UBS Securities said analyst Charles Bradford upgraded USX-U.S. Steel Group to hold from buy, citing the stock's price.
-- "We believe that investors have fully discounted potential problems in the steel business, which combined with the weakness in the U.S. Steel share price, creates a buying opportunity."

-- Said Bradford also downgraded Allegheny Teledyne Inc to hold from buy, saying stock had reached his price target of $24 a share. The benefits of the Allegheny Ludlum and Teledyne merger are offsetting weak stainless steel business, Bradford said in a report.
-- USX-US Steel was off 1/8 at 26-1/8. Allegheny Teledyne eased 1/8 at 27-3/4.
